name: obbyx
description: x402 facilitator, SDK and tooling for the Obyte network

scripts.release:check: pnpm build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --filter "!@obbyx/docs-gen" exec pnpm pack --pack-destination ../../.release
scripts.upstream:check: upstream/scripts/link-local.sh && tsc -p upstream/tsconfig.check.json && vitest run --config upstream/vitest.check.config.ts && prettier --config upstream/typescript/packages/mechanisms/obyte/.prettierrc --ignore-path upstream/typescript/packages/mechanisms/obyte/.prettierignore --check 'upstream/typescript/packages/mechanisms/obyte/src/**/*.ts' 'upstream/typescript/packages/mechanisms/obyte/test/**/*.ts'
